text.brief: A partner at a New York fund reads a term sheet in 2040 for control of a mainland port operator at a tenth of its old value. The seller is a provincial official who needs dollars before his faction falls.
text.record: The IMF put the mainland's augmented government debt at 126.6 percent of GDP in 2025 and projected 150 percent by 2029. A Hong Kong court ordered Evergrande's liquidation in January 2024. Property investment on the mainland fell 19.9 percent in the first eight months of 2026.
text.reading: A burning house invites looting. Collapsing factions sell what they took from the Chinese people, and American buyers who take the bait hand the next government a grievance and the old faction a cash exit. This is Stratagem 5, loot a burning house.
text.coreEvent: American funds buy control of major mainland state assets at distressed prices during a succession crisis before 2045.
text.gapText: Architecture Principles. American investment rules ask whether a deal is legal, not whether the seller had the right to sell.
text.fix: Refuse title from a regime in collapse and hold stolen proceeds for the people who owned them.
